articles.title: Urban Meyer Addresses Rumors on Maryland JC Job amid Brian Kelly Buzz
articles.summary: After former LSU head coach Brian Kelly was reported as a top candidate for Maryland's head coach opening, another big name option reportedly is not in the mix.
articles.body:
After former LSU head coach Brian Kelly was reported as a top candidate for Maryland's head coach opening, another big name option reportedly is not in the mix.

Pete Thamel of ESPN reported Wednesday that former Ohio State head coach Urban Meyer has not interviewed for the opening, is not a candidate being eyed by the school and "has not spoken to them in any formal capacity." Meyer confirmed Thamel's report:

Earlier Wednesday, Jeff Ermann of 247Sports reported that sources said Meyer has spoken with Maryland athletic director Jim Smith about the job with the Terrapins.

Maryland fired head coach Mike Locksley last month after a 2-5 start this season and 12 consecutive losses in Big Ten play dating back to 2025. Aazaar Abdul-Rahim took over as the team's interim coach, and the Terps have since improved to 4-6.

In addition to coaching at Ohio State from 2012 to 2018, Meyer served as head coach at Florida, Utah and Bowling Green. He led the Gators to national championships in 2006 and 2008, and he led the Buckeyes to the 2014 national title. He hasn't coached since his failed NFL stint with the Jacksonville Jaguars in 2021, in which he was fired after going 2-11 in 13 games. He's served as an analyst for Fox Sports since then.

Ermann noted that a source with knowledge of Meyer's discussion with Smith said the 62-year-old "would like something to add a more positive page to the end of his resume." He reportedly "has a warm relationship" with Smith and "also shares a relationship with Maryland deputy AD Diana Sabau."

Kelly has already interviewed with the Terps, so he could have a slight lead in the race. Ermann added that it's "unclear if Meyer has been offered the job or whether he'd accept if so, and the university would need to make a massive new investment in football to lure Meyer and a top staff, along with an expected NIL and revenue-sharing budget increase that sources have said will have Maryland's roster in the $30-35 million range next season."

It's apparent that the Terps are hoping to land a big-name hire as they enter a new era.

articles.title: Un calendario para temblar
articles.standfirst: Los culés tienen nueve partidos, en tres competiciones diferentes, antes del parón navideño
articles.summary: Los culés tienen nueve partidos, en tres competiciones diferentes, antes del parón navideño
articles.body: Tras este último parón por compromisos internacionales, el Barcelona afronta un calendario de auténtico infarto. El conjunto azulgrana tendrá que disputar nueve encuentros en apenas un mes, repartidos entre LaLiga, la Champions y la Copa. Un tramo decisivo de la temporada en el que los hombres de Hansi Flick buscarán mantener su autoridad en el campeonato regular, consolidarse en la zona alta de la clasificación europea y comenzar con buen pie su camino en el torneo del K.O. La exigencia será máxima desde el primer momento. El Barça retomará la competición este domingo con la visita al Villarreal en el Spotify Camp Nou. A partir de ahí, los azulgranas tendrán que afrontar dos desplazamientos consecutivos. El primero de ellos será especialmente exigente por la distancia. El equipo viajará hasta Azerbaiyán para medirse al Sabah FC el miércoles 25 de noviembre, en la quinta jornada de la fase de liga de la Champions League. Se trata del desplazamiento más largo para los culés hasta el momento. Sin apenas margen para descansar, el Barcelona cerrará el mes visitando al Dépor, cuatro días después en A Coruña. La primera semana de diciembre tampoco dará tregua al equipo de Hansi Flick. El calendario contempla hasta tres partidos en el Spotify Camp Nou en apenas siete días. El primero será el 2 de diciembre, cuando el Atlético de Madrid visite Barcelona en el encuentro adelantado por la disputa de la Supercopa de España. Tres días después, el día 5, será el Celta de Vigo el que se mida al conjunto azulgrana en LaLiga. El plato fuerte llegará el 8 de diciembre, con la visita del Manchester City en la sexta jornada de la Champions League. Un enfrentamiento de máxima exigencia entre dos de los grandes aspirantes. Además, supondrá una nueva oportunidad para medir el verdadero nivel del equipo ante uno de los rivales más potentes del continente. La actividad no terminará ahí. Antes de cerrar el año, el Barcelona tendrá que afrontar otros tres compromisos. El primero será a domicilio contra el Málaga, durante el fin de semana del 12 y 13 de diciembre. Después llegará el turno de la Copa del Rey, con el debut azulgrana en los dieciseisavos de final. Por último, el conjunto catalán despedirá el año recibiendo a la Real Sociedad, en un encuentro previsto para el fin de semana del 19 ó 20 de diciembre. Será el último compromiso de un tramo frenético.

articles.title: Eliminatorias Conmebol rumbo al Mundial 2030: el nuevo formato al estilo Nations League y el título que estará en juego
articles.standfirst: Giro total en Sudamérica: así se jugarán las próximas Eliminatorias con un formato estilo Liga de Naciones y un nuevo título
articles.summary: Giro total en Sudamérica: así se jugarán las próximas Eliminatorias con un formato estilo Liga de Naciones y un nuevo título
articles.body: El fútbol sudamericano se encamina hacia una transformación histórica de cara a la próxima Copa del Mundo. A raíz de la designación del Mundial de 2030 —el cual tendrá un carácter único y conmemorativo por su centenario, disputando sus partidos inaugurales en Argentina, Uruguay y Paraguay antes de trasladarse a España, Portugal y Marruecos—, la Confederación Sudamericana de Fútbol (Conmebol) analiza un cambio drástico en la estructura de su proceso clasificatorio. La noticia, revelada por Ignacio Alonso, presidente de la Asociación Uruguaya de Fútbol (AUF), en una entrevista con Carve Deportiva, anticipa la implementación de un sistema inspirado en la exitosa Nations League europea que no solo definirá los boletos mundialistas, sino que pondrá un título oficial y un trofeo en juego para todas las selecciones de la región. La celebración del centenario del primer Mundial (1930) obligó a replantear la logística del certamen global. Al confirmarse que Argentina, Uruguay y Paraguay oficiarán de anfitriones en los encuentros inaugurales de la cita ecuménica, los tres combinados nacionales obtuvieron su clasificación automática a la Copa del Mundo. Esta particularidad abrió un interrogante complejo en el seno de la Conmebol: ¿cómo estructurar unas Eliminatorias competitivas cuando tres de sus potencias históricas ya tienen su lugar asegurado y no corren el riesgo de quedar fuera? La respuesta encontrada apunta a dotar al proceso de un incentivo deportivo inédito, evitando que los partidos se transformen en simples encuentros amistosos o de preparación descafeinados para los clasificados. "Es una nueva era, con una renovación de la ilusión. La próxima Eliminatoria va a tener un formato diferente, estilo Liga de Naciones, compitiendo por un título", declaró Ignacio Alonso al confirmar los planes que se analizan en el organismo sudamericano. Aunque el reglamento definitivo todavía se encuentra en etapa de diseño y pendiente de aprobación oficial por parte de la Conmebol, los primeros detalles revelan un certamen sumamente atractivo: Todos contra todos tradicional: Se mantendría la esencia de las clásicas Eliminatorias sudamericanas, reuniendo a las 10 selecciones de la confederación en un grupo único bajo el sistema de todos contra todos, con partidos de ida y vuelta a lo largo de 18 jornadas. Un título continental en disputa: La gran novedad y el atractivo principal es que la tabla de posiciones general no solo servirá para ordenar el camino al Mundial, sino que coronará a un campeón de la Liga de Naciones de la Conmebol. La selección que finalice en la primera posición al cabo de las 18 fechas se quedará con el flamante trofeo. Competitividad para todos: Bajo este paraguas, potencias como Argentina, Uruguay y Paraguay —ya clasificadas por su condición de sedes— mantendrán la máxima exigencia competitiva al tener la oportunidad real de consagrarse campeonas continentales de este nuevo certamen, un aliciente histórico para sus vitrinas. La lucha por los cupos mundialistas: Con los tres anfitriones fijos, el resto de los cupos y plazas disponibles que otorga la FIFA para Sudamérica se distribuirán de manera lógica entre las selecciones mejor ubicadas en la tabla que aún necesiten asegurar su boleto a la Copa del Mundo. De concretarse este proyecto, la Conmebol daría un golpe de timón vanguardista en la gestión de su calendario de selecciones. A diferencia de Europa, donde la Nations League se creó para reemplazar fechas de amistosos y estructurarse en Ligas (A, B, C y D), el formato adaptado a Sudamérica aprovecha la estructura circular de sus 10 selecciones para fusionar la tensión de la clasificación mundialista con el valor agregado de levantar un título oficial. En los próximos meses se aguardan mayores precisiones formales por parte de la entidad con sede en Luque, Paraguay, en cuanto al diseño de la copa, los criterios de premiación y la oficialización del calendario que marcará el pulso del continente rumbo a la gran cita de 2030.

articles.title: Wild Grand Theft Auto Stat on SDSU Football Drops Ahead of GTA 6 Release
articles.summary: If history is any indication, Thursday's release of Grand Theft Auto 6 means San Diego State's football team is in for a rough weekend.
articles.body:
If history is any indication, Thursday's release of Grand Theft Auto 6 means San Diego State's football team is in for a rough weekend.

Per college football insider Matt Brown , the Aztecs are 0-7 all-time in their first game immediately following the release of a new GTA game.

Brown noted they are the only winless FBS team in this specific scenario.

Two of the losses come with a caveat because the game's release came several months before the Aztecs' next game. Here are the result from the other five games:

Oct. 23, 1999: Utah def. San Diego State, 38-16 ( GTA II released on Oct. 22)

Oct. 27, 2001: BYU def. San Diego State, 59-21 ( GTA III released on Oct. 23)

Nov. 2, 2002: BYU def. San Diego State, 34-10 ( GTA: Vice City released on Oct. 29)

Oct. 30, 2004: Utah def. San Diego State, 51-28 ( GTA: San Andreas released on Oct. 26)

Sept. 21, 2013: Oregon State def. San Diego State, 34-30 ( GTA V released on Sept. 17)

The original Grand Theft Auto released on Nov. 28, 1997. San Diego State's final game of the 1997 season came six days earlier, though it was a 38-17 loss to Colorado State. Perhaps they were preparing for the release in advance.

Grand Theft Auto IV was released on April 29, 2008, five months before San Diego State's season opener. The Aztecs were defeated in that game by FCS team Cal Poly, so one could interpret they were still so immersed in the adventures of Niko Bellic to fully focus on football.

Saturday was already going to be difficult for San Diego State playing on the road against No. 15 Boise State. The Aztecs do have a 3-2 record all-time at Albertsons Stadium, but the last win came in 2018.

Rockstar Games didn't even officially announce Grand Theft Auto VI was in development until 2022.

articles.title: La Selección Colombia asalta el Top 10 del Ranking FIFA después de dos años
articles.standfirst: Selección Colombia vuelve al Top 10 del Ranking FIFA: así quedó el escalafón mundial Ranking FIFA
articles.summary: Selección Colombia vuelve al Top 10 del Ranking FIFA: así quedó el escalafón mundial Ranking FIFA
articles.body: La Selección Colombia cerró el año de competencia internacional con una noticia sumamente positiva para el proceso liderado por el cuerpo técnico. Tras una última fecha FIFA caracterizada por partidos de preparación frente a la Selección de Chile, el combinado nacional escaló posiciones en la actualización oficial publicada por la FIFA, logrando un hito que no se conseguía desde mediados de 2024: meterse nuevamente entre los diez mejores equipos del planeta. Con un acumulado de 1.735,90 puntos, la Tricolor se sitúa en la décima casilla del escalafón mundial, superando a selecciones de jerarquía histórica y potencias tradicionales como Alemania, Italia, Croacia y México. Además, se consolida firmemente como la tercera mejor selección de Sudamérica, únicamente por detrás de Argentina (2°) y Brasil (7°). El regreso al selecto grupo de los diez primeros no fue casualidad, sino el fruto numérico de los resultados obtenidos en los duelos de preparación ante el conjunto austral. El primer examen se llevó a cabo en territorio colombiano, específicamente en el estadio de Cali, donde la Selección se impuso por la mínima diferencia (1-0). Días más tarde, el cierre del calendario se trasladó al Estadio Monumental David Arellano de Santiago, escenario en el que ambos combinados firmaron un empate sin goles (0-0). Si bien los puntos otorgados por la balanza matemática de los amistosos fueron sutiles —una ganancia neta de 0,10 unidades tras sumar 2,57 por la victoria y ceder 2,47 por la igualdad—, le bastaron a Colombia para capitalizar movimientos en la parte alta de la tabla y adueñarse de la décima plaza. Más allá de los números, el aspecto más destacado por la crítica y el cuerpo técnico fue la solidez defensiva, manteniendo el arco en cero en ambos compromisos a pesar de las variantes nominales. A pesar del espaldarazo que significa anímicamente volver al Top 10 del ranking, el estratega argentino Néstor Lorenzo ha optado por la mesura. Durante la concentración, el seleccionador reconoció que el equipo atraviesa una etapa de renovación indispensable. Con la mira puesta en el mediano y largo plazo, el cuerpo técnico ha aprovechado los espacios para probar caras nuevas e integrar progresivamente a futbolistas jóvenes que respondan al recambio generacional tras la salida o menor participación de referentes históricos. Sin embargo, el propio Lorenzo ha admitido públicamente que la asimilación total de la idea táctica aún está en construcción y que, por tramos de los partidos, el funcionamiento colectivo sigue sin convencer plenamente a la exigente afición tricolor.

articles.title: El Atlético conoce el camino
articles.standfirst: No es la primera vez que pierde esta temporada dos partidos seguidos. En la anterior (Liverpool y Athletic) reaccionó con ¡seis victorias seguidas!
articles.summary: No es la primera vez que pierde esta temporada dos partidos seguidos. En la anterior (Liverpool y Athletic) reaccionó con ¡seis victorias seguidas!
articles.body: Los dos varapalos sufridos ante Bayern y Barcelona han dejado tocado al Atlético. El primero ha complicado de manera sustancial su pase al top 8 (ni siquiera sumando los 12 puntos que restan lo tiene garantizado), el segundo le ha dejado sin liderato. No sólo eso, ahora los de Flick están a cinco puntos, el Madrid les ha adelantado... y el Betis acecha desde el cuarto puesto con dos puntos menos. El parón, en cualquier caso, ha servido para restañar heridas, tomar aire y que los 17 jugadores del primer equipo intentaran volver en perfecto estado físico de sus compromisos internacionales (algo que no ha sucedido con Pubill y, por la duración de su lesión, con Lookman). Los dos serán baja en el choque ante el Getafe del domingo... como también un Cuti que ha sufrido un frenazo en su recuperación. El del Coliseum será el primer choque para levantar el vuelo. El ejemplo de como caer y levantarse está cerca. Y es que esta misma temporada el Atlético sufrió dos duras derrotas seguidas. Las visitas a Athletic y Liverpool se saldaron con dos derrotas consecutivas en un mes de septiembre que despertó dudas... pero que fueron despejadas de manera inmediata. Tanto, que los de Simeone encadenaron tras esos choques seis victorias seguidas. Real Sociedad, Osasuna, Real Madrid, Alavés, Manchester United y Espanyol fueron sucumbiendo uno a uno ante los madrileños. Apenas el Stuttgart cortó la racha con un empate, que tampoco evitó que los rojiblancos volvieran al triunfo frente a Deportivo y Espanyol. En total, tras las dos derrotas: ocho triunfos y un empate... con cero derrotas. Con este precedente, se mira con optimismo al futuro. Getafe espera como primera parada antes de recibir al Viking en Champions... y jugar dos encuentros seguidos fuera de casa. Así, las visitas a Elche y Camp Nou apuntan a ver hasta dónde podrá aguantar el ritmo de la cabeza los del Cholo. Otra vez el Barça en apenas 24 días en el que será sin duda el encuentro más complicado de lo que queda de 2026. Tras el paso por el Camp Nou, otra vez al Metropolitano. Espera un Betis que está siendo la revelación de la temporada. Después, viaje Champions a Eindhoven para el clásico choque ante el PSV. La temporada se cerrará ante Valencia, en casa, y Celta, en Balaídos. Entre estos dos partidos tendrá lugar el estreno en Copa del Rey, competición que acarició el curso pasado. Sea como fuere, tres competiciones y nueve partidos para cerrar este 2026 y demostrar que se puede volver a levantar como se hizo en septiembre tras caer en San Mamés y Anfield. De momento, el Atlético ha demostrado que conoce el camino. Sólo le falta repetirlo.

articles.title: Kylian Mbappe tells Arda Guler ‘I’ll sleep better tonight’ after Real Madrid star signs contract extension until 2032
articles.summary: Kylian Mbappe expresses his happiness as Arda Guler signs a contract extension with Real Madrid, securing his future with the club until 2032. Discover the impact of their partnership on the pitch and Guler's rise in football.
articles.body: Kylian Mbappe had a simple response when Arda Guler confirmed he would be staying at Real Madrid until 2032: “Thank you. I will sleep better tonight.” The French forward’s playful message, followed by an equally warm reply from his Turkish teammate, offered a glimpse into a partnership that has become increasingly productive on the pitch. Guler’s new deal also represents a significant commitment from the club to a 21-year-old midfielder who has steadily established himself since arriving from Fenerbahce in 2023.Mbappe’s message to Guler after Real Madrid confirm contract extensionReal Madrid announced on Wednesday that Guler had signed a contract extension keeping him at the Santiago Bernabeu until June 30, 2032. The 21-year-old midfielder marked the announcement by sharing a message to supporters on social media, expressing his pride at continuing his career with the Spanish club and his ambition to contribute to its history.“Following in the footsteps of legends who have written their names in football history, in the biggest club in the world, is a great honour for me,” Guler wrote.“My dream is to wear this shirt for many years, win new titles together, and someday leave my own mark on this unique story.”Mbappe was among the first of his teammates to respond, leaving a comment that quickly drew attention: “Thank you. I will sleep better tonight.”Guler replied in kind: “We have more to do together. You are the best.”The exchange was light-hearted, but it also reflected the relationship the two players have developed since becoming teammates. Guler’s creativity and ability to find passes in the final third have made him a useful attacking partner for Mbappe, whose movement and finishing provide a natural target for the Turkish midfielder’s distribution.The renewal gives Real Madrid long-term security over a player whose importance has grown considerably since his arrival. Guler joined from Fenerbahce in 2023, aged 18, and has since made 126 appearances for the club, winning five trophies. His new agreement runs for another six seasons beyond the current campaign, taking him through to the summer of 2032.Why Guler’s partnership with Mbappe matters to Real MadridThe connection between the two was particularly evident in Real Madrid’s 3-0 victory over Valencia at Mestalla on November 7. Guler scored the second goal before setting up Mbappe to complete the scoring in the 75th minute, contributing directly to two of the three goals in a convincing away win.Their wider record together provides a clearer picture of how frequently they have featured in the same side. Mbappe and Guler have played 91 matches together across all competitions, with Real Madrid winning 65, drawing seven and losing 19. That means the club has won approximately 71 per cent of the matches in which both players have appeared.Their record in La Liga is stronger still. The pair have featured together in 63 league matches, winning 47, drawing six and losing 10. Real Madrid have therefore won close to three-quarters of their league games with both players involved.Guler has also developed beyond the role of a young prospect waiting for opportunities. His performances have made him a regular contributor under Mourinho, with his passing range, movement and willingness to take responsibility in possession giving the team another source of creativity. The Valencia match was a recent example of how his influence can extend from creating chances to finishing them himself.Who is Arda Guler? From Fenerbahce teenager to Real Madrid's long-term plansBorn on February 25, 2005, Guler developed through Fenerbahce's youth system before making his senior breakthrough in Turkey. His technical ability and composure attracted attention while he was still a teenager, and Real Madrid secured his signature in 2023 after he emerged as one of the most promising young players in Turkish football.Guler arrived in Spain in 2023 with considerable expectations, but injuries and limited opportunities initially slowed his progress. Competing with established international players, he gradually worked his way into the first team, developing into a more influential figure through his creativity, passing range and attacking contributions.His rise has now been rewarded with a long-term commitment from Real Madrid, who clearly view the Turkish midfielder as an important part of their future. With 126 appearances and five trophies already to his name, Guler has moved well beyond the status of a promising teenager, while his growing understanding with Mbappe offers another dimension to Madrid's attack.Get the latest Sports News and Live updates. articles.title: Urban Meyer reportedly not a candidate for Maryland job after early report suggesting he considered it
articles.summary: Urban Meyer is seemingly not a candidate to join Maryland.
articles.body:
Former Florida and Ohio State head coach Urban Meyer won't be returning to college after all. Despite an earlier report suggesting Meyer was " seriously considering " the head coaching job at Maryland after talking with the school's athletic director, ESPN's Pete Thamel later reported that Meyer has not officially interviewed for the job and is "not a candidate" for the role.

Meyer hasn't coached since 2021, when he was fired after just 13 games with the Jacksonville Jaguars. Prior to that, his last coaching job came with Ohio State, which he left after leading the team to a 12-1 record in 2018.

Given his success at the college ranks — he's won three national championships and is already in the College Football Hall of Fame — Meyer would undoubtedly be a significant hire for any college football program if he returns to the sidelines.

But it doesn't sound like that's going to come with Maryland, per Thamel's report.

The former coach has spoken openly about being considered for premier college football jobs in the past when his name was floated, though has yet to do that with the Maryland job.

He's fielded rumors suggesting he was considering both Penn State and a return to Florida in recent years, but shut those down . While discussing the Penn State rumors last year, the 62-year-old Meyer flat out said he has "no interest in coaching again."

Since the end of his stint with the Jaguars, Meyer has served as a college football analyst at Fox Sports. He reportedly is "happy" with that role, per InsideMDSports.com, perhaps a sign Meyer will decide against a return to coaching.

If there was a reason to believe the Maryland job would have resulted in a different outcome, it was that Meyer has pre-established relationships with a few important people at Maryland. Both Maryland athletic director Jim Smith and deputy athletic director Diana Sabau overlapped with Meyer at Ohio State, per InsideMDSports.com. Smith ran the program's alumni association at the time; Sabau was an associate athletic director at Ohio State.

That ultimately didn't mean much. Given Meyer's status in the game and his longevity at premier college programs, he's bound to have connections at nearly every major football program.

Whether Meyer truly wants to return to college football is ultimately up to him. He's been content in recent years to discuss rumors, but hasn't seemed moved to return to coaching any time soon.

The Maryland job situation didn't change that.

articles.title: Wayne Rooney: Bradford City boss Michael Duff praises 'important' comments
articles.summary: Bradford boss Michael Duff praises former England captain Wayne Rooney for speaking out about the mental health struggles he had while playing.
articles.body:
Warning: This article contains references to suicide

Bradford City boss Michael Duff has praised former England and Manchester United captain Wayne Rooney for speaking out about the mental health struggles he had during his playing career.

Rooney, 41, told Gabby Logan on the Life at the Midpoint , external podcast that he was "contemplating suicide" and drinking excessively when his son Kai, now 17, was a baby.

Duff said that Rooney's comments were "important".

"People just see a superstar earning £300,000 a week and think 'it must be all right for him' - I can assure you none of our lads are earning that but they've all got their own lives," he told BBC Radio Leeds.

"Someone at that level to come out and say at the height of his fame and playing at the top level... the release is the football pitch. That's where they're happiest.

"I think it's really good what he's done, I think it's important."

During his own playing career, Duff played alongside Clarke Carlisle, who attempted to kill himself in 2014.

The former Northern Ireland international said players "weren't educated" to look for signs that team-mates were struggling at that time.

Duff said that social media brought added issues for modern players.

"Part of the job is you get stick and abuse and sometimes it goes too far," he said.

"Everyone has an opinion but you aren't allowed to have one back. They're human beings.

"I don't go on social media. If we win people will say good things, if we don't they won't.

"There's other pressure that people don't see. They see you putting on a shirt and playing in front of 20,000 which is amazing but there's loads of other pressure in that, whether it's money or providing for a family or caring for an ill parent or all these other things the outside world doesn't see."

articles.title: Carla Ward: Republic of Ireland manager close to agreeing contract extension
articles.summary: Republic of Ireland manager Carla Ward says she is close to agreeing a new contract as she names her squad for the World Cup play-off final.
articles.body:
Republic of Ireland manager Carla Ward says she is close to agreeing a contract extension, as she named her squad for their 2027 Women's World Cup play-off final with Poland.

The former Aston Villa manager replaced Eileen Gleeson at the helm in January 2025 and has led the side to promotion to League A in the Nations League and their highest ever position in the Uefa rankings.

The Republic of Ireland have lost just one of their past six games and now face Poland in a play-off for a spot at the World Cup in Brazil next summer.

Ward's side travel to Gdansk for the first leg on 1 December before the reverse fixture four days later at Dublin's Aviva Stadium.

The 42-year-old's current deal expires at the end of the 2027 World Cup qualification cycle.

Football Association of Ireland (FAI) chief executive David Courell said earlier this month that there were "live conversations" around Ward's contract.

"I want to get one thing straight - last time I said I wanted to focus on the next four games," said Ward.

"What I mean by that is, I want the focus to be on the players and certainly not myself.

"But what I can say to everybody is, I think you all know that I love being here. I want to be here. I have absolutely no intention of going anywhere.

"Thankfully, the FAI feel the same. So yes, just to echo David's words, we're close. And look, we're happy. I'm happy. So, yeah, I'm sure you'll have me for a little bit longer."

Ward in talks over Republic of Ireland contract extension

Two down, two to go - Irish target back-to-back World Cups

Republic of Ireland to 'lock in' for World Cup dream

Saoirse Noonan returns to the Republic of Ireland squad for the Poland games after sitting out the play-off semi-final victory over Kazakhstan because of an ankle injury.

The Watford forward comes in for Jess Ziu, who has a shin injury, in the only change to the squad.

Ward said that "now is not the time for trying new things" with the squad, which includes Crystal Palace midfielder Shanade Hopcroft after her first call-up for the Kazakhstan games.

Republic of Ireland secured 3-1 and 1-0 victories over the Poles when the sides met in World Cup qualifiers in April.

Poland edged out Belgium on penalties in their semi-final and Barcelona striker Ewa Pajor poses a dangerous attacking threat.

"They're a top side, they're a really good side," added Ward.

"They've proven that. They've got arguably one of the best forwards in the world and I think that their performance against Belgium was superb, home and away. I think they were excellent.

"They created a lot. We're under no illusions that this is going to be easy because we've won two games of football against them.

"I think both sides will tweak a few things naturally because we'll both want to try and win the game. But I go back to if we focus on us, what we're good at, if we execute our game plan and everything we want to do, then I think that we can win the game."

articles.title: From kit boy to manager at 28 - Dumbarton appoint Martin Fellowes as manager
articles.summary: Martin Fellowes becomes the youngest manager in SPFL history, taking on the Dumbarton job at the age of 28.
articles.body:
Martin Fellowes has become the youngest manager in SPFL history, taking on the Dumbarton head coach job at the age of 28.

Leaving his position as assistant manager and head of football operations at Scottish League 2 leaders Stranraer, Fellowes inherits a team six places further down the ladder.

With experience on the Scotland Under-19s coaching team, Fellowes spent almost 10 years with East Kilbride, rising from teenage kit boy to a two-month spell as interim manager in 2023, winning the Lowland League Cup.

With a day job in office furniture sales, he holds a Uefa A licence.

"You have to earn people's respect as a person," Fellowes told BBC Scotland.

"When you are a young guy and you're leading a football club, I don't think you can come in and change everything and lead with an iron fist.

"You have to get people's respect on and off the pitch. I know there will be plenty of criticism and there will be plenty of people sitting here today doubting that I'm capable of doing this job at 28.

"But now really the work for me has started on, by the end of the process, having gained those people onside to say, 'he was more than capable of doing this job and we're delighted to have him here'.

"I can only do that through winning games of football."

Jim Duffy was 29 when he began his long managerial career at Falkirk and Rhys McCabe was player/manager at Airdrieonians at the same age.

Ian Cathro, now leading French club Saint-Etienne, took charge of Hearts when he was just 30.

Fellowes replaces Frank McKeown, who resigned last month, while director of football Danny Lennon had been standing in on an interim basis.

The Sons are two points off the promotion places and visit Spartans on Saturday.

"We're not going to reinvent the wheel," Fellowes added.

"We're not going to do anything that anybody else hasn't been doing.

"But if we can add the 5% to every different department and win games of football, I think over time people will understand that sometimes the age isn't a barrier but it can actually be an advantage."

articles.title: Así quedan los bombos para el sorteo de la Eurocopa 2028
articles.standfirst: España, vigente campeona, será cabeza de serie en el sorteo del 6 de diciembre en Belfast
articles.summary: España, vigente campeona, será cabeza de serie en el sorteo del 6 de diciembre en Belfast
articles.body: La conclusión de la Fase de Grupos de la Nations League terminó de perfilar los bombos de cara al sorteo para la Fase de Clasificación de la Eurocopa 2028, que tendrá lugar el 6 de diciembre en Belfast (Irlanda del Norte). España, vigente campeona, parte como cabeza de serie. Los pupilos de Luis de la Fuente comparten bombo con otras 11 selecciones: Inglaterra (anfitriona), Portugal, Francia, Alemania, Bélgica, Países Bajos, Noruega, Grecia, Italia, Dinamarca y Croacia. Las 42 selecciones restantes -son 54 en total- se dividen en otros cuatro bombos. Los bombos 2, 3 y 4 cuentan, también, con 12 selecciones. En cambio, en el bombo 5, sólo aparecen representadas seis Federaciones. La explicación es más sencilla de lo que parece: se formarán 12 grupos. Seis grupos contarán con cinco selecciones (uno de cada bombo) y otros seis únicamente con cuatro (no recibirán ninguno del bombo 5). Cuatro de estos últimos seis grupos estarán integrados por los ganadores de los cuatro cuartos de final de la de la Nations League, que se 'ahorrarán' dos jornadas de clasificación para disputar la 'Final Four' de la Liga de las Naciones. Las normas de clasificación -Rusia continúa suspendida- son sencillas. Todas las selecciones de un mismo grupo se enfrentarán a ida y vuelta y las 12 primeras de grupos se meterán directamente en la Eurocopa. Además: los ocho mejores segundos también se clasifican directamente. Por si fuera poco, cabe recordar que hay cuatro anfitrionas (Inglaterra, República de Irlanda, Escocia y Gales) que también participan en la Fase de Clasificación. Todas, al igual que Irlanda del Norte, deben ir a grupos distintos. Pues bien, hay dos plazas reservadas para las dos naciones anfitrionas mejor clasificadas que no logren acabar primeras de grupo o entre las ocho mejores segundas. En función de eso, quedarían libres entre dos y cuatro plazas -hasta completar los 24 participantes- que se decidirán en la repesca que tendrá lugar en marzo de 2028. En cuanto a fechas, destacar que la Fase de Grupos se jugará entre el 25 de marzo de 2027 -los cuatro ganadores de los cuartos de final de la Nations League comenzarán en septiembre de 2027- y el 16 de noviembre de 2027. La repesca se disputaría en marzo de 2028. El sorteo, a priori, debería dibujar un horizonte benévolo para España en función de su condición de cabeza de serie. Hay selecciones, sin embargo, que le podrían complicar el camino a los de Luis de la Fuente. En el bombo 2, sin ir más lejos, figuran seis selecciones que estuvieron en el pasado Mundial: Turquía, Suiza, Suecia, Austria, República Checa y Bosnia y Herzegovina. La renovada Serbia de Veljko Paunovic podría elevar el nivel del grupo. En el bombo 3, en cambio, ya sólo hay una selección mundialista: Escocia. A destacar, también, la Polonia de Robert Lewandowski, Ucrania o Georgia, con Kvaratskhelia. Los rivales del bombo 4 y bombo 5, a priori, no deberían ofrecer dificultades. Ahora bien, llegado el caso, Gibraltar tampoco podría compartir grupo con los de Luis de la Fuente.

articles.title: BK Hacken 0-2 Man City: Lauren Hemp and Khadija 'Bunny' Shaw on target in Women's Champions League win
articles.summary: Match report as Lauren Hemp and Khadija 'Bunny' Shaw won the game for Man City at BK Hacken; the pair came on at half-time after a goalless first half; Mary Fowler saw a late penalty saved by Jennifer Falk; Man City remain unbeaten in the Women's Champions League this season
articles.body:
After a goalless first half in which the WSL champions struggled to break down a stubborn Hacken, Andree Jeglertz played his aces at half-time, bringing on Hemp and Khadija 'Bunny' Shaw.

The England international immediately brought a spark and directness Man City had been lacking in the first 45 minutes. Aoba Fujino was their best attacking threat to that point, but was one of the players - along with Beth Mead, who was largely ineffective - who made way at the break.

It was a fortuitous opener for Hemp, although made by her own tenacity. She wriggled through two defenders into the box, with Emma Ostlund's clearance hitting her on the shin before beating Jennifer Falk.

She hit the post too not long after as Man City looked for the comfort of a second, and soon found it as Hemp and Shaw linked up perfectly.

It was almost telepathic as the winger picked up the ball deep on the left, lifting up her head for Shaw, who immediately began her run. The Jamaica international muscled through three defenders and once she had the ball at her feet, it was inevitable that she would beat the goalkeeper into the far corner.

There was late drama too as Man City were awarded a contentious penalty. Shaw went down after taking an elbow to the face from Aivi Luik as the two jumped for a high ball. The striker looked dazed as she went off the pitch, with the referee sent to the monitor by the VAR officials.

She eventually pointed to the spot with Mary Fowler stepping up. However, Falk guessed the right way as the Man City forward went for the bottom left corner.

But it did little to alter the overall result as Man City won their second Women's Champions League game, and it sends them into third on nine points. However, there are seven games yet to play on matchday five, with Jeglertz's side facing Austria Wien at home in their final league phase game on December 16.

38: BIG CHANCE! Fujino's shot is well-saved by Falk after a great run, before Yui Hasegawa skies the rebound.

45: CHANCE! Rebecca Knaack hits a wicked volley goalwards, but Falk is there to collect again.

52: SHOT!! Anna Anvegard's shot is blocked and cleared by Knaack.

55: GOAL! Hemp opens the scoring for Man City after a deflection off her shin.

57: NO GOAL! Fowler has the ball in the net, but the offside flag is up with Hasegawa standing in Falk's line of sight.

67: OFF THE POST! Hemp hits the woodwork after a great driving run, before Grace Clinton also sees her follow-up blocked.

77: GOAL! Shaw slots home after a fine pass from Hemp for Man City's second.

90+5: PENALTY! Man City are awarded a penalty after the referee was sent to the monitor by VAR. Luik is penalised for catching Shaw in the face with an elbow.

90+6: SAVED! Fowler's spot kick is saved by Falk.

Analysis from Sky Sports' Charlotte Marsh:

As if we needed a reminder, but it was clearer than ever just how influential Hemp and Shaw are for Man City after their half-time introduction.

Hemp was electric from the whistle. In the opening five minutes, she had already put in at least two crosses. Shaw made a key clearance at the other end too, proving that she can contribute across the pitch.

While Hemp's goal was created by talent and executed by luck, it was the second, as she pinged a ball forward for Shaw to finish, that truly showed why they are one of the most dangerous pairings in women's football. It was textbook from them both, but one that Hacken clearly had not studied.

Jeglertz would have been hoping to give his stars a rest, but they delivered when he needed them - ultimately what they are paid to do.

It was a shame Fujino had to be sacrificed. She was one of Man City's best players in the first half, but Beth Mead missed an opportunity to stake her claim for a regular starting spot. She offered little on her first Man City start since early October and will surely be disappointed.

But Hemp and Shaw reign supreme. It is a joy to watch them both play.

Jeglertz: We got more space in the second half

Man City boss Andree Jeglertz to the club's media: "A good game. We knew it would be a tough game to score against a very organised defending team. They have a great goalkeeper and we struggled in the first half. In the second half, they got a little bit tired, we got a little more space and we managed to get the goals.

"We try to get the best out of each player and put them in positions where they can really show what qualities they have.

"We have a great team together, we rotate players, and they all have a great impact on what we're doing. I think that will be very important in the future."

articles.title: Bruun sale al rescate
articles.standfirst: Dos goles de la danesa en el tramo final doblegan a un Inter de Milán que aguantó 43 minutos con una jugadora menos
articles.summary: Dos goles de la danesa en el tramo final doblegan a un Inter de Milán que aguantó 43 minutos con una jugadora menos
articles.body: El Real Madrid selló virtualmente su clasificación para la siguiente fase de la UWCL después de derrotar al Inter de Milán (3-1) en el Alfredo Di Stéfano. Un resultado engañoso, pues las italianas, con una menos desde el minuto 42, llevaron el partido al tramo final con tablas. Allí erigió la figura de Bruun, que con dos goles dio los tres puntos a su equipo y evitó una nueva debacle blanca. Quesada hizo tres cambios respecto al once que se impuso al París FC hace una semana y que él mismo puso como referencia en la previa. Lakrar, Beerensteyn y Caicedo suplieron a Andersson, Irune y Athenea. El diluvio universal dio pie a un partido abierto y donde penalizar el fallo. Eva Navarro avisó con dos buenas internadas por el costado diestro, respondido con un disparo lejano de Glionna que obligó al vuelo rasante de Laia. La balanza se desequilibró a favor de las locales poco antes de la media hora de acción, una jugada de 18 toques que acabó con el gol de Beerensteyn, que aprovechó la carambola del disparo de Caruso -golpeó en Schröder y Kulberg- para meter el balón en la juala. El Real Madrid hizo trabajar al VAR. Primero para pedir manos de Ivana tras un disparo de Senß que el vídeo advirtió que había golpeado en la cara de la excapitana blanca; después para pedir una roja de Vilhjalmsdóttir por pisotón sobre Caruso que dejó a las interistas con una jugadora menos sobre el campo. Pero, como no hay un partido tranquilo -ni que no encaje- del Madrid este año, el Inter recuperó el equilibrio en el tiempo de añadido. Un córner botado por Glionna y prolongado en el primer palo por Raphino fue rematado por Cambiaghi al fondo de las mallas. El Inter se reajustó tras el paso por el vestidor con un triple cambio y Quesada respondió metiendo a Keukelaar y Levels antes de la hora de juego. Gozó de una doble ocasión en un disparo de Jacinto y rechace de Schröder que sacó en ambos casos Runnarsdóttir. La islandesa repitió poco después en un remate a bocajarro de Beerensteyn. Los últimos minutos se convirtieron en un partido de frontón. A falta de cinco minutos para el final, Bruun, que había salido diez minutos antes, aprovechó un rechace tras testarazo de Méndez para romper el muro italiano. La danesa echaría el cierre en el tiempo de propina al transformar una pena máxima erigiéndose así como la gran salvadora de su equipo. El Real Madrid concluirá la fase Liga de la UWCL el próximo 16 de diciembre (jornada única) visitando a la Roma en Italia, un duelo al que el conjunto blanco podría llegar aún con aspiraciones de meterse entre los cuatro mejores de esta ronda y clasificarse así directamente para cuartos de final.

articles.title: Fifa: Football Association explored Gianni Infantino legal challenge
articles.summary: The Football Association considered challenging Gianni Infantino's eligibility to run for a fourth term as Fifa president, but it felt a case was likely to fail.
articles.body:
The Football Association has considered challenging Gianni Infantino's eligibility to run for a fourth term as Fifa president, BBC Sport can reveal.

But it believes any attempt to prevent him from standing in the election in March is likely to fail.

Infantino oversaw the introduction of a three-term limit when he replaced Sepp Blatter as leader of world football's governing body.

However, Fifa's council agreed in 2022 that his first period in office from 2016 to 2019 should not count as it was the remainder of his predecessor's interrupted final term.

Earlier this month, human rights campaign group Fair Square wrote to the FA claiming that the decision is open to legal challenge and was "contrary to the spirit and purpose" of Fifa statutes.

It urged the FA to ask Fifa's governance committee to bar Infantino from the election in March because he has already served the maximum three terms.

FA chair Debbie Hewitt has now replied, telling Fair Square that the governing body "has explored the possibility of challenging Mr Infantino's eligibility to run for a further term as the Fifa president but does not consider that such a challenge would secure the outcome sought".

In correspondence seen by the BBC, Hewitt adds: "Ultimately the process followed Fifa's governance and led to an outcome where Mr Infantino's part term was disregarded for the purposes of maximum term limits.

"Having considered the process in detail, we do not believe that a challenge would succeed."

In a statement, Fair Square said: "It's understandable that the FA has no faith in Fifa's internal processes to hold Infantino accountable for serious breaches of the rules, but it's a mistake to abandon these channels, not least because it sends a signal to Infantino that he can do whatever he likes.

"We will encourage the FA to leave its options open where this matter is concerned not least because Debbie Hewitt's position on the Fifa council puts her in a very strong position to demand clear answers on why Fifa discounted Infantino's first term."

Miguel Maduro - a former head of Fifa's governance committee - has said a national association or confederation may need to challenge Infantino's eligibility at the Court of Arbitration for Sport (Cas).

However he has also said that the ability of European football associations to do so has been made harder by Uefa president Aleksander Ceferin deciding to stand for a fourth term earlier this year. Ceferin reversed a previous insistence, in 2024, he would not seek re-election.

The FA was among a number of national associations to withdraw its support of Infantino in the wake of the crisis sparked by his failed plan to sell stakes in the World Cup and other competitions to private investors.

European confederation Uefa has backed rival candidate Philippe Diallo, the president of the French Football Federation.

Hewitt, who became a member of Fifa's council in 2023, also told Fair Square that the FA "remains opposed to Mr Infantino's re-election and is committed to providing its full support to Philippe Diallo as our preferred candidate in the upcoming Fifa presidential election".

It has previously referred to the fact that in 2022 its council "unanimously confirmed its agreement with the view of the governance, audit & compliance committee that the period between 2016 and 2019 does not count as a term of office for the current Fifa president, who is therefore about to end his first term".

articles.title: Vitor Matos: Strasbourg announce appointment of Swansea City boss
articles.summary: Strasbourg appoint Swansea City's Vitor Matos as the club's new head coach.
articles.body:
Strasbourg have announced the appointment of Swansea City 's Vitor Matos as the club's new head coach.

The French top-flight side made the announcement on Wednesday evening, but there has been no official confirmation of Matos' departure from the Swans.

Strasbourg are expected to pay Swansea compensation thought to be in the region of £5m in order to secure his services.

Matos, 38, spent just under a year at Swansea having left his role at Maritimo to succeed Alan Sheehan as the Championship club's head coach in November 2025.

Four members of Matos' coaching team - Diogo Medeiros, Toze Mendes, Goncalo Ricca and head of goalkeeping Pedro Pereira - are also expected to leave Swansea.

Ex-captain Ashley Williams is set to return to the club to join an interim coaching team also featuring fellow former players Kristian O'Leary and Leon Britton.

O'Leary and Britton are set to be the only remaining members of Matos' Swansea staff.

Alongside Williams, they will lead Swansea while the club searches for Matos' permanent successor.

Their first game will be at home to West Bromwich Albion on Saturday.

Swansea go to Middlesbrough next Tuesday before hosting rivals Cardiff City on Sunday, 29 November.

Matos moves on despite agreeing an extended Swansea contract running until 2030 in July.

Swansea were 20th in the second tier when the former Liverpool coach took over, but he leaves a team lying only three points off the top of the table in sixth.

Matos led Swansea to an 11th-placed finish last season, and has raised hopes of a potential promotion push in 2026-27 thanks to an encouraging start to this campaign.

But he told Swansea he wanted to move on after Strasbourg, who have the same ownership group as Premier League side Chelsea, made their move last weekend and he said goodbye to players and staff on Tuesday.

Having finished eighth last season, Strasbourg are 13th in Ligue 1 having won only three of their 10 league games under Hugo Oliveira, who was only appointed in the summer after Gary O'Neil departed to take over at Ipswich Town.

Latest Swansea City news, analysis and fan views

Listen to the latest Swansea City interviews, news and discussion on BBC Sounds

Matos was touted as a contender to take charge at Crystal Palace earlier this season - the Eagles have since appointed Thomas Frank - while he had also been linked with a return to Portugal on the back of his impact at Swansea.

When asked in October about the Palace links, Matos said: "I'm Swansea manager. I love being here, love my players, love the staff, so my focus is always on the next game and what we can do better."

In an interview last week, Swansea chief executive Tom Gorringe acknowledged that Matos' impact will not have gone unnoticed at other clubs.

But Gorringe played down the idea of Matos being lured away, saying: "The reality is there'll always be interest in anyone performing well in any role on and off the pitch.

"That's one of the outcomes of being successful - we're aware of that.

"[But] we're all quite happy. We've all agreed to go on this journey together and we hope that Vitor is here a long time."

articles.title: Jess Carter: England defender joins Bay FC after leaving Gotham FC as free agent
articles.summary: England defender Jess Carter completes a move to Bay FC after leaving Gotham FC as a free agent.
articles.body:
England defender Jess Carter has completed a move to Bay FC after leaving Gotham FC as a free agent.

The 29-year-old has signed a contract that will keep her with Bay FC - a club based in the San Francisco Bay Area - until 2028, with the option for an additional year.

Carter joined New York-side Gotham in July 2024 after a six-year spell with Chelsea that saw her win the Women's Super League on five occasions.

"Coming to Bay FC is a new challenge, and that's something I'm excited about," said Carter.

"I've been fortunate to be part of some successful teams, and I know how much work goes into winning. I'm looking forward to getting to know this group, earning the trust of my team-mates and doing my part to help us move forward."

Carter played in all 30 of Gotham's matches in 2026 as the club won the NWSL Shield - given to the league's regular-season champions.

She also helped Gotham win the NWSL Championship in 2025, when they defeated Washington Spirit in the final.

"Jess has been a big part of what we've accomplished as a club, and we're very thankful for the contributions she's made during her time here," said Yael Averbuch West, the president of football operations for Gotham.

Carter, who has 56 senior England caps, was part of the squad that won the 2022 European Championships, while she appeared in all six games as the Lionesses defended their title last summer.

"Jess has consistently demonstrated her quality in championship-winning environments at both club and international level," said Bay FC's chief football officer Paul Green, who worked with Carter at Chelsea.

"I've seen her development and the professionalism she brings every day. She will bring valuable experience to Bay FC, and we're delighted to welcome her to the club."

The 2027 NWSL regular season kicks off in February.

articles.title: Mykhailo Mudryk: Ukrainian Association of Football blamed for failed drugs test
articles.summary: Tottenham's on-loan Chelsea winger Mykhailo Mudryk says he blames the Ukrainian Association of Football for his failed drugs test and subsequent ban.
articles.body:
On-loan Tottenham winger Mykhailo Mudryk says he blames the administration of the Ukraine national team for his failed drugs test and subsequent ban from football.

The 25-year-old, on a season-long loan from Chelsea , was suspended from November 2024 until July 2026 after testing positive for the banned substance meldonium, which he believes entered his system while on international duty.

Having initially faced a four-year ban from the Football Association (FA), his appeal to the Court of Arbitration for Sport was successful.

He returned to football after accepting he had breached anti-doping rules and agreeing to a suspension equivalent to the time he had already served.

After appearing for Chelsea during a pre-season tour of Asia, Mudryk joined Tottenham on transfer deadline day to reunite with his former Shakhtar Donetsk manager Roberto de Zerbi.

In a lengthy interview with the Ukrainian YouTube channel Guest of Gordon, Mudryk was asked who he blamed for his absence from the game.

"The environment, the situation in the Ukrainian national team," he replied. "It should never have existed. I probably haven't said it publicly yet, but I'm saying it now.

"I had never heard of a drug like meldonium. It is a drug you can only get in Eastern Europe. It could only have got into my body in Ukraine. There is no such drug in England."

He explained how he had only been in Ukraine to be with the national team and "it points to the fact it was in a national team camp".

Asked specifically whether he blamed the national team, Mudryk replied: "Yes, exactly."

He also said Ukrainian Association of Football (UAF) president Andriy Shevchenko offered little support, blamed the association for leaks that emerged during the case and claimed its handling of the matter delayed his return to football.

Mudryk also said he spent millions of pounds on legal fees, coaching, pitch hire and private physiotherapy while being unable to access services at Chelsea .

He added: "It was a bolt from the blue. I couldn't believe it [the positive test] was true.

"It was like falling off a skyscraper. In a dream you would hit the ground. In life, I just kept on falling. It hit me very hard, mentally."

Mudryk said he cried and drank alcohol after the initial suspension but never doubted that he would eventually return to top-level football.

BBC Sport has contacted the UAF for comment.

Last year a UAF spokesperson told BBC Sport it was "in close contact with Mudryk's lawyers" but had not been contacted by the FA about the case.

articles.title: El Tenerife se da un festín y resiste con diez el arreón del Badajoz
articles.standfirst: Se fue ganando 0-3 al descanso, pero los extremeños lucharon en la segunda parte con goles y la expulsión de Jureskin
articles.summary: La expulsión de Jureskin complica el pase que los blanquiazules tenían encarrilado con el 0-3 del primer acto
articles.body: El Tenerife encarriló su clasificación copera con una primera parte muy convincente, en la que fabricó una ventaja de tres goles, y tuvo que apretar los dientes después del descanso para contener la reacción del Badajoz. La expulsión de Jureskin dio alas a los locales, que llegaron a inquietar a los blanquiazules, aunque el tanto de Chapela devolvió la tranquilidad a una eliminatoria que parecía resuelta desde muy pronto. El conjunto blanquiazul convirtió el primer tiempo en un plácido paseo. Apenas habían transcurrido cinco minutos cuando Ranos abrió la cuenta al llevar a la red un saque de esquina servido por Marc Mateu. Sin tiempo para que el Badajoz se recompusiera, Juanjo Sánchez aprovechó un error en la salida de balón del guardameta Sergio Tienza para ampliar la ventaja en el minuto 7. El Tenerife tenía el encuentro bajo control y todavía pudo aumentar su botín con un disparo de Jorge More desde unos 35 metros que se estrelló en el larguero en el 27. El tercero llegó diez minutos después, cuando Gerard Valentín asistió a Ranos, que recortó a su marcador antes de firmar su doblete. La única respuesta local antes del descanso fue una cabalgada de Guille Perero por la izquierda, resuelta por De Vuyst con una intervención con el pie derecho en el tiempo añadido. La segunda mitad cambió el decorado. El Badajoz encontró pronto motivos para creer en la remontada cuando Beitia, recién incorporado al terreno de juego, aprovechó en el minuto 47 un despeje de puños de De Vuyst para conectar un disparo desde el borde del área y recortar distancias. El panorama se complicó aún más para los visitantes diez minutos después, cuando Jureskin fue expulsado por cortar con la mano un balón siendo el último defensor. Con superioridad numérica, los locales se lanzaron a por el partido y sometieron al Tenerife a sus momentos más delicados. La respuesta blanquiazul llegó en el minuto 68. Pecar asistió para que Chapela hiciera el 1-4. Sin embargo, el Badajoz no bajó los brazos e hizo el 2-4 cuando Barba dejó una muestra de su enorme calidad al firmar el segundo tanto de los pacenses tras un recorte ante José León. El partido fue un correcalles y el Tenerife gestionó su ventaja con un hombre menos hasta concretar, en la última jugada de la cita, su quinto gol con un tanto al contragolpe aprovechando los espacios que habían dejado los locales cuando trataban de igualar la eliminatoria.

articles.title: La prórroga da vida al Mallorca y deja al Alcoyano con la miel en los labios
articles.standfirst: Los de Luis García volvieron a estar erráticos de cara a puerta durante el tiempo reglamentario
articles.summary: Los de Luis García volvieron a estar erráticos de cara a puerta durante el tiempo reglamentario
articles.body: El Mallorca ha tenido que recurrir a la prórroga ante un Alcoyano que le ha complicado mucho su estreno en la Copa del Rey. Los de Luis García se han adelantado con un gol de Abdón, pero el conjunto local ha igualado antes del descanso y ha resistido durante toda la segunda mitad. Buksa y Fuentes han roto el empate en la prórroga de una eliminatoria que ha llevado al límite a los bermellones. Dejaba claro el Alcoyano en los primeros compases de juego que iba a ser un partido cerrado y con pocas ocasiones. Por eso, prácticamente en el primer error del equipo local, Abdon Prats hizo gala de su idilio con la competición del KO para anotar el primer tanto con un potente disparo al primer palo. En el minuto 25 llegaba otra buena oportunidad para los bermellones, esta vez en un córner botado por Darder que Soumahoro mandaba por encima del larguero. 5 minutos después Orejuela desaprovechaba un mano a mano, habilitado por Abdon con un pase de espuela, en una ocasión clarísima para los de Luis García. Lo intentaba el Alcoyano con algún centro lateral que no encontraba rematador en el área hasta que en el minuto 14 remataba desviado Guille Andrés otro envío desde el costado izquierdo. Adam Buksa desaprovechaba otra ocasión muy clara para los bermellones con un envío raso desde la banda izquierda que remataba dentro del área directamente fuera. Terminaría la primera parte con una ocasión para Orejuela y, sobre todo, con el gol del empate del Alcoyano, en el que Guille Andrés aprovechaba un barullo en la defensa bermellona para poner las tablas en El Collao. Arrancaba la segunda parte en la misma línea que la primera: con el Mallorca perdonando, esta vez con un mano a mano muy claro que, inexplicablemente, Buksa echaba fuera en el 47. Habría que esperar al minuto 68 para la siguiente ocasión, un disparo desde fuera del área del conjunto local que se marchaba cerca del palo derecho de la portería de Pichu Cuéllar. Una ocasión que contestaba el Mallorca 4 minutos después con otro disparo desde fuera del área de Alex Sala. Sería la última ocasión clara del encuentro en el tiempo reglamentario mas allá de algún centro lateral de los bermellones que acababa en remate, como el de Adam Busksa en el minuto 88 que peinaba un envío desde el costado derecho por parte de Liso. Luis García movía el banquillo al inicio de la prórroga con Pablo Torre por Jandro y, poco después, Adrián Fuentes por Abdón Prats. El Mallorca apenas inquietaba en la primera mitad con algún disparo lejano de Álex Sala. Nada más arrancar la segunda, el árbitro anulaba un gol a Loren, del Alcoyano, por claro fuera de juego. Dos minutos después, Buksa cabeceaba el 1-2 a centro de Torre. En el 116, Torre daba su segunda asistencia y Fuentes sentenciaba con el 1-3. Un minuto después, Pichu Cuéllar se lució con un paradón ante un remate a bocajarro. La prórroga también dejó el debut de Mendes con el primer equipo, que entró por Soumahoro a cinco minutos del final. articles.title: Chelsea 1-0 PSG: Veerle Buurman scores late winner as Sonia Bompastor's side go top of Women's Champions League table
articles.summary: Match report as Chelsea snatched a late 1-0 win against Paris Saint-Germain in the Champions League; Veerle Buurman bundled her effort home from close range in the 88th minute; Chelsea now move to the top of the Champions League table with one league phase game to play
articles.body:
Sonia Bompastor's side looked as if they were heading to back-to-back goalless draws, following the 0-0 draw with BK Hacken last time out in Europe, until Buurman was able to bundle her effort home at the near post in the 88th minute.

The hosts had been the dominant side throughout but were thwarted by Katarzyna Kiedrzynek on more than one occasion.

Alyssa Thompson had come close to breaking the deadlock just before the break after seeing her initial shot and follow-up effort smothered by Kiedrzynek.

The corner for Buurman's timely winner arrived after the PSG goalkeeper got down well to her right to keep Sjoeke Nusken's header out.

Lucy Bronze's delivery and a slight touch on the way through sparked panic among the PSG defence and it was Buurman who reacted first to sweep home the winner, sending her side to the top of the table with one league phase game to go.

The Blues remain unbeaten in Europe, winning three of their five games so far, and are well placed to qualify for the last 16 through the top four automatic qualification spots. They face OH Leuven in their final game, where they will go into it as strong favourites.

Bompastor praises resilient team performance

Chelsea boss Sonia Bompastor speaking to UEFA:

"I like the resilience from my team. Believing until the end of the game we could score that important goal and it was really important for us to win tonight.

"What I like in my team and squad is the fact they are really flexible; they are really open-minded to changing systems sometimes, adapting to what is happening on the pitch.

"They understand really quickly. I think it was good for us to be able to change, to go to a back four. We wanted to have the width to destabilise them more than we did in the first half."

On her side potentially finishing in the top four: "We knew we had two games left and getting two wins will help us to probably secure top four.

"So we still have things under control and that was why it was really important for us to win."

Chelsea defender Veerle Buurman speaking to Disney:

"It was really important we scored the goal. Winning and three points was really important, especially after the last Champions League game where we drew against Hacken.

"A good team performance. We tried really hard and that I can score a goal is really important for the team."

Chelsea midfielder Keira Walsh speaking to UEFA:

"We spoke about it before the game about wanting to finish the evening on top. We are in a good spot going into the last game.

"It was a massive win. It was tough for us tonight. They defended really well and they're aggressive.

"It was a difficult game physically but to get the win was really important. Hopefully it will push us into the top four."

Key moments from The Cherry Red Records Stadium

43: SO CLOSE! Thompson has an initial shot and a second effort saved by Kiedrzynek from close range.

53: SAVE! Kanjinga makes space to shoot, but Hampton keeps her effort out at the near post.

67: CLOSE! Buurman meets the corner and glances her header towards goal but it is saved by Kiedrzynek again.

86: ANOTHER SAVE! Nusken's header looks destined for the bottom corner until Kiedrzynek dives to claw it away.

87: GOAL! Chelsea finally break the deadlock as Buurman scores late winner at the near post.

articles.standfirst: Se impone a A Carlos Barbosa F en la prórroga (3-1)
articles.summary: Se impone a A Carlos Barbosa F en la prórroga (3-1)
articles.body: Un gol de David Peña en el quinto minuto del primer tiempo de la prórroga permitió a Illes Balears Palma Futsal imponerse a A Carlos Barbosa F (3-1) y disputar su cuarta final de la Copa Intercontinental, mañana (23:00, DAZN/IB3). Mucho tuvieron que trabajar los de Antonio Vadillo para alzarse con el triunfo. En la primera rotación de Peri Alves Fuentes, la entrada de Murilo Carlos Saad marcó el desarrollo del partido. El habilidoso jugador brasileño controló en el área, sorprendió a Dennis Cavalcanti con una vaselina y marcó a placer. El propio Murilo pudo hacer el segundo de chilena, pero Dennis sacó una oportuna mano para evitar a córner. El Illes Balears no fue el de las grandes noches. Le costó entrar el partido, y su falta de acierto, le exigió siempre un esfuerzo más. Al menos, los de Vadillo evitaron que A Carlos Barbosa F consiguiera un segundo gol que podría haber sido definitivo. En el segundo palo encontró el Illes Balears la solución y ahí fue donde Diego Nunes consiguió conectar con Charuto para empatar el partido. Quedaban más de siete minutos por jugarse y los porteros, Dennis Cavalcanti y Pedro Bianchini mandaron el partido a la prórroga. En la prórroga fue mejor el Illes Balears Palma. Esta vez Lucao encontró a David Peña, que se desgañitaba pidiéndole el balón, en el segundo palo. Luego, la expulsión de Marcolla facilitó durante dos minutos las cosas y ya con Murilo Carlos Saad de portero jugador, Dennis Cavalcanti hizo el tercero. articles.title: Endrick deshoja la margarita
articles.standfirst: El brasileño sopesa los pros y los contras de una posible salida en enero... y Mourinho decidido a retenerlo porque considera que seguir en el Madrid también le ayudará a crecer
articles.summary: El brasileño sopesa los pros y los contras de una posible salida en enero... y Mourinho decidido a retenerlo porque considera que seguir en el Madrid también le ayudará a crecer
articles.body: Endrick tiene una decisión importante por delante. El delantero brasileño se acerca al mercado de invierno con varias cuestiones sobre la mesa y sin tener claro cuál es el mejor camino para su futuro. Quiere jugar más, necesita continuidad para seguir creciendo y sabe que una salida en enero podría ofrecerle ese protagonismo que todavía no ha encontrado en el Madrid. Sin embargo, tampoco tiene prisa por marcharse. Está feliz con Mourinho, se siente querido por el entrenador portugués y sabe que permanecer en Valdebebas también puede ser una buena opción para su desarrollo. La Roma es uno de los destinos que más fuerza ha ganado en las últimas semanas. Gasperini está especialmente interesado en el brasileño y su nombre ocupa un lugar destacado en la lista de prioridades de D'Amico para reforzar el ataque. El técnico italiano ve en Endrick un perfil que encaja en sus planes y ambos incluso llegaron a conversar después del encuentro entre el Madrid y la Roma en el Olímpico. La posibilidad de incorporarse a un equipo que disputa la Champions League es, además, un argumento que seduce especialmente al futbolista. El Sporting, que también había aparecido entre los posibles destinos, ha perdido fuerza en los últimos días. En cualquier caso, la Roma no es la única alternativa que puede aparecer en el horizonte del delantero. En el otro lado de la balanza está Mourinho. El entrenador portugués quiere seguir contando con Endrick y no tiene intención de perder efectivos en el mercado de enero. Conoce perfectamente que el brasileño necesita jugar con mayor regularidad, pero considera que quedarse en el Real Madrid hasta final de temporada también le permitirá evolucionar. La estabilidad, el trabajo diario y la posibilidad de continuar creciendo dentro de una plantilla de primer nivel forman parte de su argumento. Además, la relación entre ambos es muy buena. Endrick está contento con el trato que recibe del técnico, que se preocupa por su situación personal y mantiene una relación cercana con él. El propio futbolista dejó entrever recientemente que su futuro no está decidido. "No sé qué pasará en enero, eso está en manos de Dios. Solo pido lo mejor para mi carrera", reconoció durante su concentración con Brasil. Una declaración que refleja las dudas que acompañan al delantero. Su prioridad es encontrar continuidad. "Solo quiero jugar, ser feliz, ayudar a mis compañeros, marcar goles y dar asistencias, como pude hacer en Lyon", explicó, recordando su experiencia en Francia, donde encontró el protagonismo que ahora busca. Endrick tampoco esconde la dificultad de hacerse un hueco en el Real Madrid. Con Mbappé por delante, las oportunidades son limitadas y el brasileño es consciente de que necesita aprovechar cada ocasión. Pero también tiene motivos para valorar su permanencia. "Tengo mucha fe en Mourinho. Todos los días viene a preguntarme cómo estoy, pero nunca habla de fútbol, sino de mi vida personal", contó sobre el entrenador portugués. La decisión no está tomada. Endrick escucha, analiza las posibilidades y sopesa qué opción le permitirá dar el siguiente paso en su carrera. La Roma le ofrece un proyecto atractivo, la posibilidad de jugar la Champions y la confianza de un entrenador que le quiere. El Real Madrid, por su parte, le ofrece continuidad en un entorno que conoce y el respaldo de un Mourinho que no quiere dejarle salir. Entre la necesidad de jugar y la estabilidad que le ofrece Valdebebas, el brasileño deshoja la margarita.
